title: Cobra Effect Lab
one_liner: Design an incentive, then watch an animated population simulation backfire exactly like the podcast's historical disasters.
headline: Pick an incentive scenario (rat bounty, bank quota, ticket quota), crank a pressure dial, and watch a 10-week animated chart show the "official metric" soar while the real outcome quietly craters — then compare it to what actually happened.

episode.title: Flying Tesla Car, Robot Brains Halving in Cost Every 3 Weeks, and Why Incentives Decide AI Alignment | #303

history.summary: A tight, well-polished build that nails the cobra-effect concept with three scenarios, a single incentive dial, a live canvas chart splitting official metric vs. real outcome, a gaming-strategy reveal banner, and a historical-facts closing card. This is clearly a second pass: every must_fix and most improvements from the prior review (disabled-button state, mismatched fallback icon, color-only line distinction, missing radiogroup keyboard nav, static-tone reveal text) have been addressed. It's publishable as-is, with only minor polish items remaining.
